root.label: Bolivia arrests Roger Mariaca and 13 others

events.label: Bolivia arrests Roger Mariaca and 13 others

slots.name: arrest count
slots.sentence: Bolivian police arrested Attorney General Roger Mariaca at Viru Viru International Airport in Santa Cruz, two days after the United States revoked his visa over allegations linking him to drug trafficking and corruption.

slots.name: prosecutors detained
slots.sentence: The other detainees included two prosecutors also targeted by this week’s U.S. visa sanctions, part of a broader round of travel bans affecting over a dozen officials across South America.

slots.name: senior officials arrested
slots.sentence: Government Minister Marco Antonio Oviedo said Thursday that Mariaca was arrested on suspicion of involvement in a criminal organization, money laundering and drug trafficking, Bolivian broadcaster Unitel reported.

slots.name: arrest date
slots.sentence: Anti-drug prosecutor Miguel Gonzales said late Wednesday that police had detained Mariaca without a warrant.

events.label: Bolivia plans parliamentary commission on Mariaca allegations
